package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/queryfields"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/admin/v1/middleware"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/admin/v1/parsers"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/catalog"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"
)

// TrackHandler handles track endpoints.
type TrackHandler struct {
	Validator *validator.Validate
	CreateUC  catalog.CreateTrack
	UpdateUC  catalog.UpdateTrack
	DeleteUC  catalog.DeleteTrack
	GetUC     catalog.GetTrack
	ListUC    catalog.ListTracks
}

// CourseLevelHandler handles course level endpoints.
type CourseLevelHandler struct {
	Validator *validator.Validate
	CreateUC  catalog.CreateCourseLevel
	UpdateUC  catalog.UpdateCourseLevel
	DeleteUC  catalog.DeleteCourseLevel
	GetUC     catalog.GetCourseLevel
	ListUC    catalog.ListCourseLevels
}

// CourseGroupHandler handles course group endpoints.
type CourseGroupHandler struct {
	Validator *validator.Validate
	CreateUC  catalog.CreateCourseGroup
	UpdateUC  catalog.UpdateCourseGroup
	DeleteUC  catalog.DeleteCourseGroup
	GetUC     catalog.GetCourseGroup
	ListUC    catalog.ListCourseGroups
}

type catalogTranslationRequest struct {
	I18nID      int    `json:"i18n_id" validate:"required,min=1"`
	Title       string `json:"title" validate:"required,max=255"`
	Description string `json:"description" validate:"required"`
}

type catalogCreateRequest struct {
	ID               string                      `json:"id" validate:"omitempty,uuid"`
	Slug             string                      `json:"slug" validate:"required,ascii,max=255"`
	SourceKey        string                      `json:"source_key" validate:"omitempty,max=255"`
	Order            *int                        `json:"order" validate:"omitempty,min=0,max=32767"`
	Status           *int                        `json:"status" validate:"omitempty,oneof=0 1"`
	LessonReadAccess *domain.LessonReadAccess    `json:"lesson_read_access" validate:"omitempty,oneof=guest student student_pro disabled"`
	Translations     []catalogTranslationRequest `json:"translations" validate:"omitempty,dive"`
}

type catalogUpdateRequest struct {
	Slug             string                      `json:"slug" validate:"required,ascii,max=255"`
	Order            *int                        `json:"order" validate:"omitempty,min=0,max=32767"`
	Status           int                         `json:"status" validate:"oneof=0 1"`
	LessonReadAccess optionalLessonReadAccess    `json:"lesson_read_access"`
	Translations     []catalogTranslationRequest `json:"translations" validate:"omitempty,dive"`
}

func (h TrackHandler) Create(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req catalogCreateRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	item, err := h.CreateUC.Handle(r.Context(), catalog.CreateTrackInput{
		ID:               req.ID,
		Slug:             req.Slug,
		SourceKey:        req.SourceKey,
		Order:            req.Order,
		Status:           req.Status,
		LessonReadAccess: req.LessonReadAccess,
		Translations:     mapTrackTranslations(req.Translations),
	})
	if err != nil {
		writeCatalogError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(item)
}

func (h TrackHandler) Update(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req catalogUpdateRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	item, err := h.UpdateUC.Handle(r.Context(), catalog.UpdateTrackInput{
		ID:                  chi.URLParam(r, "trackID"),
		Slug:                req.Slug,
		Order:               req.Order,
		Status:              req.Status,
		LessonReadAccess:    req.LessonReadAccess.Value,
		LessonReadAccessSet: req.LessonReadAccess.Set,
		Translations:        mapTrackTranslations(req.Translations),
	})
	if err != nil {
		writeCatalogError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(item)
}

func (h TrackHandler) Get(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	item, translations, err := h.GetUC.Handle(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "trackID"))
	if err != nil {
		writeCatalogError(w, err)
		return
	}
	if !catalogReadPrivileged(r) && item.Status != domain.CatalogStatusActive {
		writeCatalogError(w, domain.ErrNotFound)
		return
	}
	fields := queryfields.Parse(r.URL.Query().Get("fields"), queryfields.TrackCatalogAllowedFields)
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"track": buildTrackFields(*item, translations, fields, resolveLang(r.Header.Get("Accept-Language")))})
}

func (h TrackHandler) List(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	filter, err := parsers.ParseTrackFilters(r, h.Validator)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	_, role, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	filter.ActiveOnly = !ok || !isPositionPrivilegedRole(role)
	items, err := h.ListUC.Handle(r.Context(), filter)
	if err != nil {
		writeCatalogError(w, err)
		return
	}
	fields := queryfields.Parse(r.URL.Query().Get("fields"), queryfields.TrackCatalogAllowedFields)
	response, err := h.mapTrackListResponse(r, items, fields)
	if err != nil {
		writeCatalogError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"tracks": response})
}

func (h TrackHandler) Delete(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if err := h.DeleteUC.Handle(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "trackID")); err != nil {
		writeCatalogError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

func mapTrackTranslations(translations []catalogTranslationRequest) []domain.TrackI18n {
	result := make([]domain.TrackI18n, 0, len(translations))
	for _, translation := range translations {
		result = append(result, domain.TrackI18n{I18nID: translation.I18nID, Title: translation.Title, Description: translation.Description})
	}
	return result
}

func mapLevelTranslations(translations []catalogTranslationRequest) []domain.CourseLevelI18n {
	result := make([]domain.CourseLevelI18n, 0, len(translations))
	for _, translation := range translations {
		result = append(result, domain.CourseLevelI18n{I18nID: translation.I18nID, Title: translation.Title, Description: translation.Description})
	}
	return result
}

func mapGroupTranslations(translations []catalogTranslationRequest) []domain.CourseGroupI18n {
	result := make([]domain.CourseGroupI18n, 0, len(translations))
	for _, translation := range translations {
		result = append(result, domain.CourseGroupI18n{I18nID: translation.I18nID, Title: translation.Title, Description: translation.Description})
	}
	return result
}

func catalogReadPrivileged(r *http.Request) bool {
	_, role, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	return ok && isPositionPrivilegedRole(role)
}

func writeCatalogError(w http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
	if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
		return
	}
	if err == domain.ErrConflict {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusConflict)
		return
	}
	http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
}
